headline: Chicago wins twice; Inter Miami blanks D.C. 4-0
dek: A 15-match slate across Oct. 7, 11 produced heavy scorelines, a pair of draws out west, and no shortage of road wins.
body: Chicago Fire beat Vancouver 3-1 on Oct. 7, then turned around and downed New York City FC 2-1 on Oct. 10. Inter Miami thrashed D.C. United 4-0. Red Bull New York put four past San Diego FC. FC Cincinnati won 3-1 at Atlanta. Nashville SC, Seattle Sounders, and Portland Timbers all came away from road trips with points. Out west, LAFC and Vancouver drew 1-1, Colorado and San Jose shared a 1-1 result, and Minnesota and Houston finished 2-2.

headline: Charlotte doubles down; Fire add Hanche-Olsen from Mainz
dek: Charlotte promoted two Crown Legacy forwards before the roster freeze; Chicago's summer centre-back acquisition is now on the books.
body: Charlotte FC signed forwards Nathan Richmond and Hugo Mbongue from MLS NEXT Pro affiliate Crown Legacy FC ahead of the Oct. 9 roster freeze deadline. Richmond, 22, registered eight goals and 10 assists in 24 Crown Legacy appearances this season. Mbongue, 21, tallied 14 goals in 22 matches for the affiliate. Stephen Eustáquio departed LAFC after 720 minutes this season; his loan from Porto expired June 30, and he returned to FC Porto. Chicago Fire's Andreas Hanche-Olsen, signed from Bundesliga side Mainz 05 in September, is now formally on the roster.

headline: Musa leads Golden Boot at 19; xG gap widens for two outliers
dek: FC Dallas's striker holds a two-goal cushion at the top, while two forwards are beating, and two are lagging, their expected-goals marks by historic m
body: Petar Musa of FC Dallas leads all scorers with 19 goals. Milan Iloski (Philadelphia Union) and Brian White (Vancouver Whitecaps) are tied at 17. In assists, Anders Dreyer of San Diego FC tops the chart at 12, one clear of Albert Rusnák (Seattle, 11), with Son Heung-Min of LAFC at 10. Houston's Guilherme has scored 14 goals against an xG of 6.8, a gap of plus-7.2. NYCFC's Nicolás Fernández sits at 15 goals on 8.7 xG. Going the other direction, Chicago's Philip Zinckernagel has six goals on 10.7 xG, and Inter Miami's Germán Berterame seven on 11.5.

headline: Nashville lead East by distance; Vancouver top in West
dek: The Eastern Conference leader holds the league's stingiest defence and most commanding points total heading into the final weeks.
body: Nashville SC lead the Eastern Conference with 63 points on a 19W-6D-3L record, conceding only 22 goals, the best defensive record in the league. Inter Miami CF have scored 68, the most in MLS. In the West, Vancouver Whitecaps top the table with 51 points (15W-6D-7L), having scored 61 and conceded 30. Andrés Cubas of Vancouver leads the tackles chart with 103, 26 clear of Yannick Bright of Inter Miami (77), with D.C. United's Silvan Hefti third at 65.

headline: Chicago put three past Vancouver in home rout
dek: The Fire handed the Western Conference leaders a 3-1 defeat at home, their heaviest loss of the season.
body: Chicago Fire FC beat Vancouver Whitecaps 3-1 on October 7 to hand the Western Conference leaders their sharpest defeat of the campaign. The result arrives at a difficult moment for Vancouver, who sit atop the West on 50 points with a 15W-5D-7L record but now carry a loss to a side outside the playoff picture. Chicago will take confidence from a performance that produced three goals against the league's most-tackled unit.

headline: Lingr exits Houston for Polish top flight
dek: The Czech midfielder leaves the Dynamo after 930 minutes this season, heading to Ekstraklasa side Korona Kielce.
body: Houston Dynamo FC have transferred midfielder Ondřej Lingr to Polish top-flight side Korona Kielce. The 27-year-old Czech international logged 930 minutes for Houston in the 2026 MLS season before the move was completed. Lingr arrived at the Dynamo in March 2025 as a Designated Player signing from Slavia Prague and made 43 MLS appearances during his time with the club.

headline: Musa leads White by one with clock ticking
dek: Three strikers from three conferences are separated by just two goals as the scoring title enters its final stretch.
body: FC Dallas forward Petar Musa leads the MLS golden boot race on 18 goals. Vancouver's Brian White sits one back on 17, with Nashville SC's Sam Surridge a further goal behind on 16. In the assists table, Albert Rusnák of Seattle Sounders and San Diego FC's Anders Dreyer are level on 11, one clear of LAFC's Son Heung-Min on 10.

headline: Nashville defense anchors dominant East lead
dek: The Eastern leaders carry the league's best attack and best defense; the West is tighter, with Vancouver clinging to top spot.
body: Nashville SC lead the Eastern Conference on 60 points with an 18W-6D-3L record, having conceded only 21 goals, the stingiest defense in the league. Their 55 goals scored also rank among the best, though Inter Miami CF holds the outright attack record with 64. In the West, Vancouver Whitecaps top the table on 50 points, 29 goals conceded against 60 scored, but October 7's loss to Chicago adds pressure at the summit.

headline: Chicago hands Vancouver a 3-1 defeat at Soldier Field
dek: The Fire picked up three points at home, dealing the Western leaders a blow on the road.
body: Chicago Fire FC defeated Vancouver Whitecaps 3-1 on October 7 to collect a vital home win. The result is a setback for Vancouver, who lead the Western Conference on 50 points from a 15W-5D-7L record. Brian White, the Whitecaps' top scorer on 17 goals this season, could not prevent his side from dropping the three points on the road.

headline: Zambrano arrives in New England from Real Salt Lake
dek: The 21-year-old forward joins the Revolution on a permanent transfer from Real Salt Lake in exchange for a 2029 second-round SuperDraft pick.
body: New England Revolution have acquired forward Marcos Zambrano from Real Salt Lake. The 21-year-old Ecuadorian-born, US youth international brings professional experience from Benfica B and Vitória Guimarães B before his stint in Utah. Zambrano tallied seven goals in ten appearances for Real Monarchs in MLS NEXT Pro this season and has earned 18 caps for the United States Under-20 side, scoring seven goals at youth international level.

headline: Musa leads White by one as Surridge lurks at 16
dek: FC Dallas's Petar Musa holds a one-goal cushion at the top with just weeks of the regular season remaining.
body: Petar Musa of FC Dallas leads the Golden Boot race with 18 goals. Vancouver's Brian White sits one back on 17, and Nashville SC's Sam Surridge is two further behind on 16. Nashville's own attack has been built on efficiency: the club's 21 goals conceded is the best defensive record in the league, while their 60 points and 18W-6D-3L Eastern Conference mark puts pressure on every rival.

headline: Guilherme running 7.3 goals clear of his xG floor
dek: Houston's forward and NYCFC's Fernández are finishing well above expectation; Almirón and Zinckernagel remain mired in conversion debt.
body: Houston Dynamo's Guilherme leads all overperformers: 14 goals against an xG of 6.7, a positive gap of plus-7.3. Nicolás Fernández of New York City FC sits at 15 goals on an xG of 8.6, plus-6.4. On the other side, Atlanta United's Miguel Almirón has posted just 4 goals against an xG of 9.1, a deficit of minus-5.1. Chicago Fire's Philip Zinckernagel shows 6 goals on an xG of 10.6, minus-4.6, a notable drag on a side that just beat Vancouver.
